title: O002-G1 Joint Unseen-Person × Unseen-Stimulus Generalization
purpose: Test whether the strong reported-state baseline and the physiology incremental-utility result generalize when the test participant and the test video are both absent from training.

outer_evaluation.rule: For each of 30 subjects and 8 videos, test only rows from that subject on that video. Training excludes every row from the held-out subject AND every row from the held-out video.
outer_evaluation.rationale: Prevents both person leakage and stimulus/video leakage. This is stricter than ordinary leave-one-subject-out.

omitted_feature: video_id is deliberately excluded because the test video is unseen by definition.

learner.tuning: Training-only GroupKFold by subject, up to 4 folds; held-out subject and video never enter tuning.
learner.preprocessing: Median imputation and standardization fit only on each training fold.

primary_quantities.prior_increment: MAE(context_only)-MAE(prior); positive favors prior reported state.
primary_quantities.physiology_increment: MAE(prior)-MAE(physiology); positive favors physiology beyond prior report.

uncertainty.procedure: Sample 30 subjects with replacement and 8 videos with replacement, then average the paired cell-level delta over the Cartesian product of sampled subjects and sampled videos.

decisions.REPORT_PERSISTENCE_GENERALIZES: prior_increment 95% CI strictly above zero for both axes.
decisions.PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT_GENERALIZES: physiology_increment 95% CI strictly above zero for an axis.
decisions.NO_PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT_UNDER_DOUBLE_HOL: physiology_increment CI is not strictly above zero for either axis.
decisions.MIXED_GENERALIZATION: Different axes support materially different patterns.

firewall: This is an out-of-distribution predictive robustness test, not a causal experiment.
A physiology increment under double holdout would not establish causal embodiment; a null would not establish physiological irrelevance.
The recent-report predictor remains self-report and is not assumed available in sensor-only deployment.
No phenomenal identity or consciousness inference.
publication_role: Directly addresses multiplicative/generalization concerns raised by recent affective-computing benchmarking and tests whether the paper's central incremental-information pattern survives simultaneous person and stimulus novelty.
